messages.text:
"Create a fully playable retro-style military strategy game called BLACK OPS: SHADOW CORPORATION.

The player owns and manages a secret private black-ops corporation, hiring operatives, purchasing firearms and armor, and accepting dangerous contracts around the world to earn money and expand the company.

Use a 1980s military computer aesthetic with black backgrounds, glowing green tactical maps, pixel graphics, CRT scanlines, radar sounds, and military radio chatter.

During missions, friendly operatives appear as light-green dots, enemies as moving red dots, and objectives as yellow markers. Players command their operatives to infiltrate locations, avoid enemy patrols, complete objectives, and reach extraction points.

When enemies detect operatives, pause the game and offer two choices: FLEE or FIGHT. Fighting triggers a cinematic retro pixel-art firefight with immersive gunfire, explosions, radio chatter, and battlefield ambience. Combat outcomes depend on skills, weapons, armor, and enemy strength.

Include operative recruitment, unique names and skills, experience progression, equipment upgrades, salaries, headquarters management, worldwide contracts, financial rewards, and randomly generated missions.

Permadeath is essential. Operatives killed during missions are permanently lost and must be replaced. Record fallen soldiers in a memorial.

Add a Government Heat Meter that increases after failed missions, excessive casualties, and exposed operations. If it reaches 100%, the government launches a crackdown that could destroy the corporation.

Start with $100,000, three rookie operatives, basic equipment, and low-risk contracts. Unlock elite soldiers, better weapons, larger teams, and more dangerous missions as the company grows.

Make the game playable on mobile and desktop with functional controls, enemy AI, stealth mechanics, tactical combat, saving, and progression.

Core gameplay: Recruit → Equip → Accept Contract → Infiltrate → Avoid or Fight → Complete Objective → Extract → Get Paid → Expand.

Make every decision matter. The ultimate goal is to build the world's most powerful secret military corporation while balancing PROFIT, SURVIVAL, and SECRECY.

Build a working playable game, not just a visual demonstration.
"
